body: Slippage checks use stale snapshot (High): the panel validates max slippage and estimate-ready using formSnapshot from onFormStateChange, but handleSubmit places orders from the formState argument. Those can lag by a render, so slippage can be evaluated for one size/direction while a different order is submitted, or skipped when the snapshot still looks empty while submit proceeds.
action: Submit guard now derives market/amount/direction from the authoritative formState and only trusts the estimate when formSnapshot matches the submitted order exactly; otherwise the market order is blocked.
